hebrewText: אַף אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְ/תִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִ/פְנֵי אֵֽל

tokens.bdb: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
to break up (usually figuratively), i.e. to violate, frustrate
tokens.kjv: [idiom] any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, [idiom] clean, defeat, disannul, disappoint, dissolve, divide, make of none effect, fail, frustrate, bring (come) to nought, [idiom] utterly, make void.

tokens.bdb: fear (also used as infinitive); morally, reverence
to scrape off; by implication, to shave, remove, lessen, withhold
tokens.kjv: abate, clip, (di-) minish, do (take) away, keep back, restrain, make small, withdraw.
